title: feat(app-shell): Studio Interfaces pillar creates a page and opens it on source plus live preview (objectui#11823 step 3)
body:
Fixes #11823

Clause-②: no

Step 3 of objectui#11823, **the card's last item**: Studio's Interfaces pillar creates a **page** in a writable package, links it from the open app's navigation, and opens it on its **source beside a live preview** (ADR-0084; objectstack `docs/design/builder-ui.md` §6: "source + live preview for react / html pages"). Steps 1 (`bee5d6f`, PR objectui#11868) and 2 (`a49c4bd`, PR objectui#11907) have landed, so this PR completes the card.

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 3 PM (claim `6054175190`, amendment `6054208157`), session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`.

## What changed

- **New page** on step 2's **New** menu, after *New dashboard* and *New report*, offered under the same conditions (a writable package, an app to link from, nav editing closed).
- **The dialog** is the shared `CreateItemDialog`, unchanged; its existing `extra` slot asks for the source kind (`PageCreateFields`): **HTML** (the default) or **React**. React is offered only where the host runs react pages (`isCapabilityEnabled(CAP_REACT_PAGES)`): a deployment that set `OS_PAGE_REACT=off` would accept the page at the door, but the preview and the running app would only say react pages are disabled. The kind is asked here because the Studio cannot change it later (a source page's Properties tab edits no kind).
- **The handler** is step 2's `doCreateSurface`, gaining the `page` kind with the same five steps: refuse a name any page already holds (published or draft, any package) and write nothing; save the draft (`client.save('page', NAME, body, { mode: 'draft', packageId })`); append the nav entry and send it through `doNavSave`; select the leaf; Design mode. For a page it also puts the rail on its **Source** tab and expands a collapsed rail, so the code editor shows whatever tab an earlier source page left the rail on.
- **The body** (`buildPageSkeleton` in `interfaceCreate.tsx`, typed as the spec's `Page`): `{ name, label, type: 'app', kind, source }`.
  - `type: 'app'` is written because `PageSchema` defaults an absent `type` to `record` (measured below), and a record page cannot be opened by a `page` nav entry: it needs a record id the entry cannot pass, and the nav editor's own picker leaves record pages out (`isStaticPageOption`).
  - `source` cannot be empty: the spec refuses an html or react page without one. The starter is one paragraph of text from the designer table (`engine.studio.interfaces.create.pageStarter`, en and zh), in the kind's own syntax: for html a `flex` column (direction col, gap 4) holding one `p` element; for react a `function Page()` returning a `div` with an inline `style` (flex column, gap 16) holding that `p`. No Tailwind class (ADR-0065). The deprecated `jsx` spelling of `html` is never written.
- **The nav entry** is `{ id, type: 'page', pageName, label }`. It carries the typed label, as a report entry does: the spec's label inheritance stops at object, view and dashboard targets, so a label-less page entry shows its `pageName` (measured below).
- **Strings:** 12 new `engine.studio.interfaces.create.*` rows (en and zh), and the existing `menuTitle` row (en and zh) now names pages.

Untouched: `CreateItemDialog.tsx`, `SourcePageEditor.tsx`, `PagePreview.tsx` (import only), `DashboardPreview.tsx`, `NavTree`, `StudioNavItemInspector`, `useDraftAutoSave`, `doPublish`, `index.ts`, `packages/i18n/**`, `packages/components/src/ui/**`.

## The brief's Zone 2, measured

1. **Step 2's shape** holds as described; the page joins the same menu and handler with kind `page`.
2. **The skeleton.** Installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0 `PageSchema`: an html, react or jsx page with a non-empty `source` parses; an empty or missing `source` is refused at `source` ("A html page requires a non-empty `source`"); a page with no `type` parses as `type: 'record'`. The published 17.7.0 draft door (`objectstack dev --fresh`): the html starter answered 200 and read back with `requires: ["ui"]` stamped (the server compiled the starter's source); the react starter 200; an empty source 422 `INVALID_METADATA` at `source`; a page without `type` 200, read back as `type: "record"`. **Default kind: html**, the parse-never-execute tier every deployment renders; react runs author code and a deployment may switch it off.
3. **Opening it.** Selecting the new leaf opens the pillar's existing pair: `SourcePageEditor` `mode="preview"` on the canvas and `mode="editor"` in the rail's Source tab. Pinned, and read in a real browser below.
4. **The nav entry label** must be carried: in the running app (17.7.0, published) a label-less page entry read `team_board` in the sidebar, the labelled one `Team board`.

## Tests and gates (local HEAD `da775d5`: this branch with `main` `4ebc250` merged in, no rebase)

The new pins:

- `StudioDesignSurface.interfacesCreatePage-11823.test.tsx` (7 tests, the mounted pillar with the real `SourcePageEditor` and the runtime page renderer): New page saves an html page `PageSchema` parses and an app document `AppSchema` parses, with the labelled `page` entry appended; the rail shows the leaf; the rail's code editor holds the starter source and the canvas (not the rail) draws the starter paragraph; a React page is written and previewed the same way; the rail opens on Source even when an earlier source page left it on Properties; a page name taken in another package, or by a draft, is refused in the dialog with no write; controls: the menu reads New dashboard, New report, New page, and a read-only package shows no New.
- `interfaceCreate.test.tsx` (+12 tests): both kinds parse as app pages and pass `isStaticPageOption`; controls: without `type` the spec reads a record page, and an empty source is refused at `source`; each locale's starter line holds none of the four characters the html parser stops at or JSX text refuses; the html starter compiles and renders through the runtime `SchemaRenderer` in en and zh, and the react starter runs and renders; the page entry carries its label and parses in an app document; `PageCreateFields` offers HTML and React starting on HTML, and only HTML when react pages are turned off.
- Step 2's `StudioDesignSurface.interfacesCreate-11823.test.tsx` is unchanged and green (the dashboard and report flows).

**Reverse checks** (implementation committed first, HEAD `b5e418a`, through `ablation-replace.mjs`, restore proven by blob):

- Drop only the page's nav entry (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`: `navigation: [...navigation, entry]` becomes `kind === 'page' ? navigation : [...navigation, entry]`; anchor 1 to 0, blob `188223c` to `b132bd5`). Predicted: the page create pin red, step 2's pins green. Observed `Tests 1 failed | 16 passed (17)`: the saved navigation lacked `nav_team_handbook`; step 2's file 10 of 10 green. Restored: blob equals HEAD `188223c`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Drop the Source-tab reset (`setInspectorTab('source')` deleted; blob `188223c` to `a7e3b2e`). Predicted: only the Properties-tab pin red. Observed `Tests 1 failed | 6 passed (7)`, that pin. Restored: blob equals HEAD. A first attempt in replace mode was refused by the tool itself (the replacement is a substring of the anchor, so its count could not rise); no test ran, and its restore was proven the same way.

**Lint, narrowed and measured:** `eslint --format json` over the 5 touched TS files, under the root `eslint.config.js` (the only config; the package script is `eslint .`): 5 files, 0 errors, 21 warnings. `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 13 warnings = 13 on `main` `4ebc250`; `interfaceCreate.tsx` 8 `react-refresh/only-export-components` (5 on `main`: the module exports builders beside its components, as in step 2). The config sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

**Published surface:** after `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell build` (`da775d5`, dist completeness 1022 files), walking relative imports from `dist/index.d.ts` reaches 174 declaration files, `StudioDesignSurface.d.ts` (control) included and `interfaceCreate.d.ts` / `CreateItemDialog.d.ts` not; `StudioDesignSurface.d.ts` does not name `interfaceCreate`. No export, prop or `packages/i18n` key is added.

## Real browser (published `@objectstack/*` 17.7.0, Playwright/Chromium)

Server: `objectstack dev --fresh` in a scratch directory with a code package `com.probe.code` (an object, an html page, an app) and a writable package `com.probe.ui` with an app. Console: this branch under Vite, read on `b5e418a` and again on `da775d5`. Monaco's CDN loader is blocked in this container, so the rail's editor is `SourcePageEditor`'s textarea fallback.

- The New menu read New dashboard, New report, New page; the dialog's kind read HTML, React, on HTML.
- *New page* "Team handbook": `PUT /api/v1/meta/page/team_handbook?mode=draft&package=com.probe.ui` 200 with `{"name":"team_handbook","label":"Team handbook","type":"app","kind":"html","source":...}`, then `PUT .../meta/app/probe_ui_app?mode=draft&package=com.probe.ui` 200 with `{"id":"nav_team_handbook","type":"page","pageName":"team_handbook","label":"Team handbook"}` appended. The canvas (Design) drew "A new page. Write its content in the source editor."; the rail's Source tab was selected and held the starter source; no compile error.
- *New page* "Team board", React: `PUT .../page/team_board` 200 (kind `react`), the app 200; the canvas drew the starter through the react runtime.
- Editing the source in the rail ("Welcome to the team handbook." and "Edited in Studio.") showed on the canvas at once and autosaved one `PUT .../page/team_handbook` 200 with the new source.
- "Team handbook" again: refused in the dialog ("A page with the identifier “team_handbook” already exists. ..."), 0 writes.
- Code package `com.probe.code`: no New menu.
- After Publish (`POST /api/v1/packages/com.probe.ui/publish-drafts`, 3 published, 0 failed): the running app's sidebar listed Item, Team handbook, Team board; `/apps/com.probe.ui/page/team_handbook` showed the heading "Team handbook" and the edited body; Team board showed the react starter.

## Acceptance notes

- **Studio's live preview omits the page title the running app shows.** `SourcePageEditor`'s preview hands the runtime renderer the draft without `pageType` (the runtime's `PageView` maps the spec's `type` to it), so the renderer treats every source page as a record page: no title heading, record width. Measured above: the Studio canvas shows no "Team handbook" heading; the running app does. `SourcePageEditor` is import-only on this claim; reported to the seat with the reproduction. It applies to every html or react page, not only new ones.
- In the narrow folded layout (the chat dock open on a narrow viewport), a new page opens on the Canvas tab (the preview), and the editor is the Properties tab, as for any source page: two tabs, not side by side.
- A second create in the same session sends the app document as the previous nav save left it, which carries the server's `_packageId` stamp; the 17.7.0 door accepted it (200) and `AppSchema` declares it. Step 2's path, unchanged here; noted only.

## Overlap

`git merge-tree` of this head with each open objectui PR touching `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, `interfaceCreate.tsx` or `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` (read 2026-10-08T08:21Z: only objectui#11931, which shares `i18n.ts` in other rows) is clean. Whoever lands second merges `main`.
